label: Correctness of the scoped epistemic judgment varies within the actual selective history
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, the realist no-relation horn, attribution deferred. Some scenario with the actual selective history differs from the actual scenario in whether the judged content is correct. Stance-independence of correctness does not by itself entail this: a realist who takes epistemic correctness to supervene necessarily on descriptive truth-conduciveness denies it.
